performance.verdict: CPL crisis is real; but 5 overdue SOW milestones risk the August scoreboard entirely.

findings.text: CPL spiked 49.4% in 7d on near-flat spend (-2.12%); last 3 days yielded only 7 leads vs 15 in prior 3 — confirmed efficiency collapse.
5 SOW milestones overdue (oldest: 2026-07-23 renewal; latest: 2026-08-31 dashboard + scoreboard decision) — August prove-it window has already closed with no confirmed delivery.
GBP actions collapsed -61.67% in 7d; last 3 days show 0 GBP actions vs a prior-3 average of ~3.7 — organic floor is gone and paid has no offset.
105 GHL opportunities created (28d) but 0 won and 0 appointments recorded — leads are entering the pipeline but not converting; intake leak, not an ads problem.
Google Ads spend is $0 across all 28 days; SOW notes budget should shift mainly to Google/LSA per the 7/19 call — this channel shift never executed.

suggestions.text: Refresh top Meta retargeting creative on 'BWS - Instant Leads - Retargeting' ($384.81 of $749.28 spend) — CPL +49.4% signals fatigue.
suggestions.monday_update: CPL rose 49.4% in the last 7 days on near-flat spend, with the BWS - Instant Leads - Retargeting campaign consuming $384.81 of the full $749.28 budget. Introduce at least 2 new ad creatives into this campaign to test against the fatigued set. Success is CPL returning below its 28-day baseline of $7.35 within the next 7 days. Re-check by 2026-09-17.

suggestions.text: Escalate 5 overdue SOW milestones to Sohib immediately; August scoreboard is closed with 0 confirmed dashboard or attribution deliveries.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones are overdue, the oldest dating to 2026-07-23, including the August scoreboard dashboard and renewal decision both due 2026-08-31 — neither is marked complete. The client's explicit condition for renewal was a trusted scoreboard showing leads → schedules → shows → new patients. Sohib must confirm status of each milestone and communicate directly with Dr. Jamal and Lily before the next billing cycle. Target: all 5 milestones confirmed complete or formally deferred with client sign-off by 2026-09-13.

suggestions.text: Investigate GHL intake: 105 opportunities, 0 appointments, 0 won — confirm Flex Dental handoff and new intake hire coverage are functioning.
suggestions.monday_update: The GHL pipeline shows 105 opportunities created over 28 days with 0 appointments recorded and 0 won — leads are arriving but not being scheduled, which is an intake issue not an ads issue. Confirm the Flex Dental texting handoff is live, that the new intake hire is actively working leads, and that appointment records are syncing correctly from OpenDental to GHL. Success check: at least 10 appointments visible in GHL pipeline by 2026-09-17.
